## Summary
Implement real-time Core Web Vitals monitoring (LCP, FID, CLS) with automated alerts and analytics dashboard.

## Problem
- No visibility into actual page performance
- Core Web Vitals are critical for SEO and user experience
- Slow pages hurt revenue and retention

## Proposed Solution
1. Integrate Web Vitals SDK (Google Analytics)
2. Set up automated performance monitoring
3. Create custom dashboard for tracking LCP, FID, CLS
4. Configure email alerts for performance degradation

## Expected Impact
- Identify performance bottlenecks early
- Improve SEO rankings (LCP, CLS directly affect rankings)
- Better user experience → higher retention

## Changes
- Add WebVitalsProvider component for automatic metric collection
- Implement useWebVitals hook with threshold checking
- Create API endpoints for metrics storage and reporting
- Add admin performance dashboard with real-time metrics
- Configure alert thresholds (warning/critical)
- Track metrics by page type (home, tool detail, blog, category)

## Metrics Tracked
- **FCP**: First Contentful Paint (≤ 1.8s good)
- **LCP**: Largest Contentful Paint (≤ 2.5s good)
- **CLS**: Cumulative Layout Shift (≤ 0.1 good)
- **FID**: First Input Delay (≤ 100ms good)
- **TBT**: Total Blocking Time (≤ 200ms good)
- **TTFB**: Time to First Byte (≤ 800ms good)

## Access Points
- **Dashboard**: `/[locale]/admin/performance`
- **Reports API**: `/api/analytics/reports?period=7d&format=csv`

## Test Plan
- Access dashboard at `/[locale]/admin/performance`
- Verify metrics are being collected
- Check that alerts trigger at configured thresholds
- Test CSV report generation

Closes #283
